exposure: previous two lower segment caesarean sections (LSCS)
cohort: 192 patients with previous two lower segment caesarean sections (LSCSs) out of 4087 confinements of ANC patients at D Y Patil Hospital Navi Mumbai.
finding: Patients with two prior LSCSs had increased rates of complications including placenta previa (6%), abnormal placentation (2%), severe adhesions (28%), atonic PPH (15%), blood transfusion (12%), bladder/bowel injuries (8%), scar rupture (2%), scar dehiscence (6%), obstetric hysterectomy (2%), maternal ICU admission (19%), and neonatal ICU admission (25%).
